title: About Me
text:
Hi, I’m Josh Hardesty, a class of 2025 graduate with a B.S. in Biology from SUNY Oneonta.
My academic interests include fish and wildlife ecology, genetics and evolution, and data analysis using R and GIS.
Check out some of my work!
